description: This is a Python source file for a GUI application and associated threading and socket communication logic related to the 'beerocks_analyzer' tool. It manages log file reading, network communication, and GUI interactions for the Beerocks Analyzer.

classes.name: UpdateSig
classes.description: A QObject subclass with a Signal to emit float values for updating GUI elements.

classes.name: BeeRocksAnalyzer
classes.description: Main QMainWindow subclass managing the GUI, log file reading, threading, and network communication for the Beerocks Analyzer tool.

classes.name: SocketServerThread
classes.description: Thread class that opens a socket server to receive data and write to a log file.

classes.name: BeerocksCliThread
classes.description: Thread class to run the beerocks_cli binary locally or in a Docker container, managing its process.

classes.name: SSHThread
classes.description: Thread class to establish an SSH connection and run beerocks_cli remotely.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the Beerocks Analyzer application.

methods.name: signal_handler
methods.description: Handles system signals (e.g., SIGINT) to terminate threads and quit the application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the QApplication and creates the main BeeRocksAnalyzer window.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the main application window and starts the Qt event loop.
